title: This Bird Sleeps in Plain Sight and Still Sees You
subject: potoo

scenes.text: This bird sleeps in plain sight with its eyes shut. But it can still see you.
It's a potoo. Its gray-brown feathers look exactly like tree bark.
By day it sits perfectly still on a broken branch, head stretched upward, eyes closed.
It looks like part of the tree. A stump, with nobody home.
But tiny slits in its upper eyelids let it sense movement, even with its eyes shut.
At night it wakes up and snatches flying insects, and even bats, out of the air.

description:
The potoo looks like a broken tree branch, and tiny slits in its eyelids let it sense movement with its eyes shut.
At night it snatches insects and bats out of the air.
Have you ever spotted a bird like this?
first_comment: A tree stump that wakes up and eats bats. Be honest, could you spot one?
